def maxRotateFunction( nums: List[int]) -> int:
    n = len(nums)
    F = 0
    total_sum = sum(nums)
    maxF = F
    k = 1
    
    while k < n:
        F = F + total_sum - n * nums[n - k]
        maxF = max(maxF, F)
        k += 1
    
    return maxF
